Definition: pleasure; hence (abstractly) desire; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind)
BiblicalUsage: 1) delight, pleasure; 1a) delight; 1b) desire, longing; 1c) the good pleasure; 1d) that in which one takes delight
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
